title: Included Miles by Storage Unit Class on Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Free Move-In Claims
content:
On a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental free move-in claim, the unit-class miles depend on the class of the claimed storage unit, as the unit class stands on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement:

| Class of the claimed storage unit | Unit-class miles added to the included-miles allowance |
|---|---|
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | **25** |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | **25** |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | **10** |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | **10** |
| Any other class | 0 |

## Notes

- The class read is that of the storage unit the free move-in is claimed for, not of any other unit the renter holds.
- Illustration (hypothetical): a renter claiming for a Bluegate Climate Plus unit adds 10 miles; had the claimed unit been a Bluegate Premier Climate Suite, 25 miles would be added.
